purpose: Recheck the focused MySQL atomicity and PostgreSQL rollback-failure layer on the current fork/linux tip. This is not the final frozen B3+B4 candidate.

mysql_atomic.coverage: InnoDB transactional rollback; MyISAM, MEMORY, CSV and ARCHIVE trigger effects across failed INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE; AUTO_INCREMENT and trigger session-variable effects.

postgres_rollback_failure.assertions: Reports TransactionRollbackFailed; transactional parent and trigger rows roll back; identity and trigger sequence advances remain.

hosted_boundary: The Build Linux run for this tip was cancelled; no hosted B4 rollback result is claimed here. The final candidate remains to be frozen after B3 closes.
